data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $11.732 million, representing 29.27% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This overall strengthening is the net effect of mixed developments across older underwriting years. While the closed years 2007 to 2012 produced a surplus (release), the 2013 account experienced a 'pure loss' (adverse development) which, combined with other prior year movements, resulted in a net strengthening for the portfolio of prior years.

data.data_quality_notes: The report contains both gross and net loss ratio development triangles. The gross loss ratio triangle is provided in the _claims_triangle field. Gross premiums written per underwriting year are not available, preventing the calculation of prior year development from the loss ratio triangle in absolute terms. The prior year development figure is derived from the 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' line in the Claims Outstanding reconciliation table (Note 12).
